name: Amy Adams Strunk

views.text: Two years without improvement is impossible to ignore.
I hire a president of football operations to run the searches; I set the standard.
Spending in free agency is fine, but it has to show up in the standings.
A new coach gets a second season, but not an open-ended one.
This franchise owes its fans more than a long rebuild.
A young quarterback is the center of any plan we make.

motivation.want: a return to contention and a new stadium era that starts with winning
motivation.fear: a long losing stretch that defines her stewardship

want.text: to see Cam Ward lead the Titans back

voice: Reserved and formal in public, speaking mostly through statements. Emphasizes accountability and improvement. Leaves football detail to her executives.

evidence.summary: Strunk fired GM Ran Carthon after two seasons and a 9-25 record despite a big free-agent spending spree, saying the lack of improvement could not be ignored; Brian Callahan was kept for a second year.
President of football operations Chad Brinker was put in charge of the general manager search.
